name: SpinW SW12: triangular easy plane (3×3 magnetic cell)

metadata.spin_representation: spin expectation values, not magnetic moments
metadata.normalization: <0|S_i|one magnon>; one quantum per magnetic cell; no per-site rescaling
metadata.hamiltonian_convention: Native SpinW exchange and classical anisotropy matrices are unchanged
metadata.q_convention: q_export=-diag(nExt)*qmat*q_input; SpinW native Fourier sign reversed for exp(+iq.R-iwt)
metadata.goldstone_note: SpinW may add omega_tol to a singular Hamiltonian; exact Goldstone amplitudes are not unique
